description: Wire the frontend to the Python backend. Create src/api.ts (typed async fetch client for all /api/* routes), update src/screens/AdminReview.tsx (make PromptReview.handleSubmit call POST /api/admin/reviews/{id}/classify), update src/screens/Training.tsx (fetch live model stats from GET /api/models and show in the Model Training Status table), and add the /api proxy to vite.config.ts pointing to localhost:8000. This FEAT depends on FEAT-001 establishing the API contract, but the file changes are independent of each other and can be done in any order within this FEAT. src/data.ts, src/types.ts, and all other screens are unchanged.
steps:

  In the table rows map: change from {models.map(...)} to {(liveModels.length > 0 ? liveModels.map(m => ({ id: m.resource, name: `${m.resource} Security Model`, resource: m.resource as ResourceType, status: m.status as ModelStatus, trainingSamples: m.training_samples, detectionAccuracy: m.detection_accuracy, lastTrained: m.last_trained ?? 'Never', attacksDetected: m.attacks_detected, version: m.version, trainingHistory: [], attackCategories: [], progress: 0 })) : models).map((m) => (<tr ...> ... </tr>))}.
  Add ResourceType and ModelStatus to the import from '@/types'.
  No JSX changes — only the data source changes. The mobile card section gets the same treatment.
  Active Training Jobs cards section: keep reading from trainingJobs (static) — unchanged.
